Can someone please answer me a quick question about whether you can upgrade disk copies of games with online upgrades on the PS4.

Game disks from all manufacturers are sold as non-writable.

The upgrades will add a "patch" or other code to the hard drive and run that code when the disk is loaded in place of the code on the game disk.

So purchasing the upgrade from the store would write the new data to the hard drive on the PS4. allowing you to play the game.
